class.name: JRPGSetMovementRouteCommand
class.brief_description: Event command: makes the player or an event follow a movement route.
class.description: The player ([constant CHARACTER_PLAYER]), the event running the command ([constant CHARACTER_THIS_EVENT]) or event [member character] of the map follows a route ([member route_commands], with [member repeat] and [member skippable], see [JRPGMoveRoute]) instead of its own movement until the route ends; a route given while another runs replaces it. With [member wait] the event waits until the route has ended (a repeating route never does); a blocked move waits for the way to clear unless the route is skippable. The player's route steps are not counted as steps, and the player's input waits while a route moves them. It goes through the event host ([method JRPGEventHost.set_move_route]); without one, or without such a character on the map, nothing moves, with a warning. Authority: server.

members.member: Who follows the route: [constant CHARACTER_PLAYER], [constant CHARACTER_THIS_EVENT] or an event's ID.
The route starts again when it ends.
The route's commands, each [lb]code, arguments...[rb] (see [enum JRPGMoveRoute.Code]).
A blocked move is skipped rather than waited out.
The event waits until the route has ended.

constants.constant: The [member character] of the event running the command.
